money.purpose: Every amount, value, ID, and code; tabular numerals always.

shadows.name: register
shadows.purpose: Raised plates on the black ground (dark).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Money-green keyboard focus ring on inputs.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Default easing; the only authored transition family.

components.name: Primary Button (dark)
components.description: The money action on the black till.
components.css: .ds-btn { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #3ddc8e; color: #04130b; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #35c57b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3ddc8e; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(61,220,142,0.18); }

components.name: Status LED
components.description: Status is a lit LED, never a pill.
components.css: .ds-led { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 6px; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #3ddc8e; } .ds-led-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3ddc8e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(61,220,142,0.15); } .ds-led-overdue { color: #ff5c62; } .ds-led-overdue .ds-led-dot { background: #ff5c62; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,92,98,0.15); } .ds-led-cancelled { color: #7c9488; } .ds-led-cancelled .ds-led-dot { background: #7c9488; opacity: 0.6; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Money Plate (stat card)
components.description: The daily register: mono label, large mono value, hairline rule, LED.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: #101612; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.13); border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #7c9488; } .ds-value { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 1.563rem; font-weight: 700; color: #eef4ef; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

components.name: Input / Field
components.description: Hairline stroke, transparent interior, money-green focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.13); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #eef4ef; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #55685d; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #35c57b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(61,220,142,0.18); }

components.name: Sidebar Active Item
components.description: Active rail item is a green-filled block with dark text, no side stripe.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #0a0f0c; padding: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-nav-item { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #cdd3ce; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 4px; margin: 2px 8px; } .ds-nav-active { background: #3ddc8e; color: #0a0f0c; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3ddc8e; outline-offset: -2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Auth Card Plate
components.css: .ds-auth { background: #101612; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.13); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 20px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); width: 100%; max-width: 400px; margin: 0 auto; overflow: hidden; padding: 24px; } .ds-auth h2 { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; color: #3ddc8e; margin: 0 0 16px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

narrative.overview: The interface is the everyday SA phone-banking screen rebuilt as a whole product world: a terminal-grade money interface where the operator stands beside the till and reads the day at a glance. The world has two states of matter — the black till at night (the default engaged screen) and the paper ledger in daylight (the lighter theme and the printed invoice sheet). On both, money is the hero: every amount is a tabular Space Mono figure sitting on a ruled plate, statuses are LEDs rather than pills, and the only color that means anything is the money green.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black graphite ground with raised plates every surface sits on.
1px hairline rules create the ledger; nothing floats off the grid.
Status is a lit LED (6–8px dot), never a badge pill.
Money, codes, and data always render in tabular Space Mono.
Flat hard corners (4–12px); buttons are flat rects or green fills.
Dark is the flagship theme; light paper is the secondary mode and the invoice sheet.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Money green is used sparingly and always means money or action. It appears as a fill, a hairline, or a focus ring — never as a gradient, glow, or ambient wash.

rules.name: The LED Rule
rules.body: A status is a lit dot (6–8px, fully rounded, colored, optionally a soft 3px halo ring). Never a pill, badge, or gradient chip. Canceled/unread states dim to 60% opacity.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every displayed amount, value, or code uses Space Mono with tabular numerals. Ordinary body text never uses the mono face; mono is reserved for data and measurement.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows respond only to state (hover, focus, elevation). A zero-offset glow is a decoration and banned.

dos: Do set every page field to the theme's ground and every surface on it a raised plate.
Do render every amount, value, ID, and code with Space Mono tabular numerals.
Do represent status with a colored 8px LED dot (with its soft halo) and a mono label.
Do keep corners categorical: 4px buttons/chips, 6px cards, 12px modals and auth plates.
Do use the money green as a flat fill, hairline, or focus ring — it is earned, not ambient.
Do keep animations to a single authored moment with expo ease-out, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or colored border-left/border-right stripes above 1px on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't use bounce easing, layout-triggering width/margin animations, or glow blobs.
Don't use a badge pill for status, decorative illustrations, or a SaaS blue-green corporate palette.
Don't use monospace for non-data prose; mono is reserved for measurement.
Don't add kickers/eyebrows above headings, section numbering as decoration, or hard offset block shadows outside a genuinely neobrutalist world.
